test_objective: Check that you can retrieve a list with a detailed representation of NGSI-LD entity types

test_cases.name: 023_01_01 WithoutJsonLdContext
test_cases.doc: Check that you can retrieve a list with a detailed representation of NGSI-LD entity types
test_cases.template: Retrieve Details Of Available Entity Types
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/types'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve entity types: and
    Query Parameter: context set to '${EMPTY}' and
    Query Parameter: details set to 'true'
}

test_cases.name: 023_01_02 WithJsonLdContext
test_cases.doc: Check that you can retrieve a list with a detailed representation of NGSI-LD entity types
test_cases.template: Retrieve Details Of Available Entity Types
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/types'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve entity types: and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: details set to 'true'
}
